description: This file defines the TriState class, which represents a three-state boolean logic (True, False, Unknown). It includes constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and methods to get and set the state. The class is part of the Thunder::Core namespace and is used for handling tri-state logic in the project.

classes.name: TriState
classes.description: A class representing a three-state boolean logic with states True, False, and Unknown. Provides constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and methods to manipulate and query the state.

methods.name: TriState()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the state to Unknown.

methods.name: TriState(const TCHAR* text, const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state based on a text input, recognizing 'T', 'F', 'TRUE', 'FALSE', case-insensitive.

methods.name: TriState(EnumState state)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state directly with an EnumState value.

methods.name: operator=(const bool rhs)
methods.description: Assigns a boolean value to the TriState, setting it to True or False.

methods.name: operator=(const EnumState rhs)
methods.description: Assigns an EnumState value to the TriState.

methods.name: operator==(bool other) const
methods.description: Checks equality with a boolean value.

methods.name: operator!=(bool other) const
methods.description: Checks inequality with a boolean value.

methods.name: operator OptionalType<bool>()
methods.description: Converts the TriState to an OptionalType<bool>, representing Unknown as empty.

methods.name: Set(bool value)
methods.description: Sets the state to True or False based on the boolean input; returns true if the state changed.

methods.name: Set(EnumState value)
methods.description: Sets the state to the specified EnumState; returns true if the state changed.
